system.description:
Attack with Disadvantage; it replaces all your attacks this round. On a hit, the target makes a Fortitude save or is Stunned for 1d2 rounds.

Combat Manoeuvres, Manoeuvre: replaces one attack.

The save DC is 10 + half your level (minimum 1) + your Strength modifier. A creature that saves against your Shield Blow is immune to it for the rest of the fight.

Switch it on from the Actions tab while it applies; the sheet adds the Advantage or Disadvantage.

rules.value: Shield Blow: on a hit the target makes a Fortitude save or is Stunned for 1d2 rounds
